exposure: pH and base excess of funiculus blood at birth
cohort: This study included 41 children diagnosed with hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy (HIE) at birth (average age 9.09 years) and a control group of 38 healthy subjects (average age 9.57 years).
finding: Thickness reduction of the inner retinal layer and peripapillary nerve fibre impairment was related to encephalopathy severity (Sarnat score II-III) and treatment with therapeutic hypothermia, and was associated with inflammation (increased C-reactive protein and lactate dehydrogenase) and cerebral oedema.
